Raj: Quick heads-up — we need to open a cloud support request for EU (eu-west-1) to raise several limits to support the Dedicated GPU pool expansion. Cloud account: `123456789012`. Primary asks: GPU instance quota, ENIs, EIPs, NAT gateways, and VPC route table limits. Need this for both steady-state capacity and burst windows.

Maya_li: Which instance families / exact quotas do you want bumped? also are these for Dedicated (private VPC) or hosted?

Raj: Dedicated (customer-owned VPCs via Private). Forecast & ask: 
- Q2 (30 days): steady 40 GPUs concurrent, want quota to 60 to allow room.
- Q3 (90 days): steady 120 GPUs, need quota 200 for headroom + bursts.
- Burst windows: nightly batch jobs (00:00-05:00 UTC) may spike 2-3x for short periods; request ability to burst up to 25% above steady.
Specifics to request in ticket:
```
- EC2 GPU instances: p4d/p4de (A100-like) from 20 -> 200 (soft limit ask with phased increases)
- Elastic IPs: 5 -> 50
- Elastic Network Interfaces (ENIs): region total + per-instance ENI increase
- NAT Gateway / NAT connections: support for additional throughput + additional gateways
- VPC route table association limit: increase to support many small customer VPCs
```
Put justification: dedicated pool for low-latency inference + scheduled high-throughput model evals.

Ben_k: I'll open the AWS support ticket. We should also loop in our EU account manager for a quota review — they'll sometimes approve faster with a usage forecast. Can you add expected monthly GPU-hours and an estimated cost impact?

Raj: Sure. Estimated monthly GPU-hours: Q2 ~ 30k GPU-hours, Q3 ~ 120k GPU-hours. Rough monthly cost (on-demand equivalent) ~ `€65k` at Q3 peak — will refine. Add note that we prefer Capacity Reservations or Savings options discussion once limits are confirmed.

infra-bot: Created support case: `AWS-S-0-9999999999-abcde` — https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=AWS-S-0-9999999999-abcde

Anna-cloudops: For Dedicated pools we should consider a mix: Capacity Reservations for baseline (steady), and on-demand burst for spikes. If they require guaranteed headroom during business hours we might need Convertable RI/CR planning. I'll draft cost delta for CR vs pure on-demand.

Alice_fin: Please add cost center `ENG-INFRA-DED` to the ticket and a short budget approval note. Finance will pre-approve up to `€40k/mo` during ramp; anything > that needs exec signoff.

Sre-oncall: Recommendation from SRE: keep 30% warm spare capacity in region to handle AZ failures + autoscaling warm-up. Also request ENI headroom because we hit ENI limits before CPU/GPU in small clusters.

Maya_li: For networking: we also need more NAT gateway IPs and increase per-VPC active connections (NAT LB scaling). I'll attach a sample VPC layout and the number of customer endpoints per VPC to the ticket.

Ben_k: Assigned tasks: 
- I'll own the AWS ticket follow-ups and CC the account manager.
- Maya to attach VPC/network details.
- Anna to produce CR vs on-demand cost comparison.
- Raj to provide final forecast + business justification.

Raj: Thanks — tagging @maya_li @ben_k @anna-cloudops @alice_fin. I'll update the case with the Q2/Q3 numbers and add the budget tag. :thumbsup:

Sre-oncall: Also adding note: set autoscaler cool-down to 5m for burst reclaim, and use prefix/KV caching to reduce token cost during spikes (ops-level suggestion).

Ben_k: Next steps: I'll paste ticket link in this thread when we get an update and create a short runbook for capacity-reservation ops.

Raj: LGTM, let's track in the ticket and sync in next infra weekly.
